content:
arjun: morning folks, quick cloud access Q on my first week. I need AWS SSO access to assume the Dedicated role and GCP project access for 'redwood-private-eu' (eu-west1). Also need to view billing for redwood-eu-billing. Who do I ping and what's the usual turnaround?

emily: welcome! tag @infra for AWS SSO (permission set 'DedicatedAccess') and open a billing request for Finance. Turnaround is usually same-day for SSO if you have 2FA + security key enrolled.

arjun: thanks — is there a template for the billing request? and do I need any service account bindings for deployments?

finance-bot: Submit a billing request here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/BillingRequest. Use the "Billing Access" template and include: requester email, team, projects, and why you need view/edit access.

infra: FYI we attach the SSO permission set to your SSO subject and add you to group 'dedicated-engineering'. We won't change org-level roles. For GCP, cloud-sre usually grants 'roles/viewer' on billing project and 'roles/iam.serviceAccountUser' on project for the deploy SA.

cloud-sre: For eu-west1 GPUs you might need quota increases. Open a quota request in GCP Console and cc @cloud-sre so we can escalate. If you need access to platform-deploy@redwood-private.iam.gserviceaccount.com, mention that in your ticket.

oncall-bot: Created INF-612: "SSO + GCP billing access for arjun" assigned to infra. ETA 1 business day.

arjun: perfect — i've enrolled my security key and filed the billing ticket. tagging infra/cloud-sre on the quota request if we hit GPU limits. Appreciate the help! :tada:
